1. Core and Authentication
WebAppSanityPackage.Login
Validate successful sign-out by logging in, opening the user menu, verifying 'View Profile Details', and clicking 'Sign Out'.
Validate login failure with invalid password and assert message: 'Login Information is Incorrect, 3 wrong attempts will lock your Account'.
Validate empty-credentials errors and assert messages: 'Email is required' and 'Please enter a valid password'.
Validate invalid email format and assert message: 'Please enter a valid email Id'.
Validate inactive-user login block and assert message: 'Account is not activated!! Please contact support-stage@habitnu.com for assistance'.
Validate deactivated-user login block and assert message: 'Account is deactivated! Please contact support-stage@habitnu.com for assistance'.
Validate missing-password error when only email is entered and assert message: 'Please enter a valid password'.
Validate missing-email error when only password is entered and assert message: 'Email is required'.
Validate case-insensitive email handling and assert auth error message contains: 'Login Information is Incorrect'.
Validate blur-triggered field validations and check messages: 'Email is required' and 'Please enter a valid password'.
Validate unregistered-email login attempt and assert generic error contains: 'Login Information is Incorrect'.
Validate password visibility toggle behavior by confirming the password input type changes from password to text and back to password.
Validate OTP login happy path by requesting an email OTP, fetching the latest code from TestMail, submitting it, and verifying arrival on Home.
Validate invalid OTP handling and assert message: 'Code entered is wrong'.
Validate Forgot Password with registered email and assert success message: 'Password Reset Link Sent Successfully!'.
Validate Forgot Password success modal and assert exact text: 'Password Reset Link Sent Successfully!'.
Validate Forgot Password with unregistered email and assert one supported error text appears: 'This email is not registered', 'Invalid email', or 'Could not find any users matching email'.
Validate reset confirmation modal content and behavior, asserting texts: 'Password Reset Link Sent Successfully!' and 'Your password can be reset by clicking the link in your email'.
Validate end-to-end password reset flow and key messages: 'Passwords do not match' and success text 'Password successfuly updated', then store used reset link for reuse validation.
Validate one-time reset-link enforcement and assert expired-link message: 'Password url has been expired'.
Validate localization switch to Spanish by selecting ES and verifying login UI text reflects Spanish language content.
Validate Register navigation from login page opens HabitNu signup in a new tab and loads expected signup/login page content.
Validate Register navigation on Project Power opens the ADA Project Power page in a new tab and displays expected branding elements.
WebAppSanityPackage.HomePage
Verify that the dashboard header shows the logo, discussion icon, notification icon, and profile menu.
Verify that the notification badge is either not shown or shows a valid non-negative count.
Verify that Home, Food, Health, Learn or Videos, and Habits links are visible in the main navigation.
Verify that the Home navigation link is marked as active on the dashboard.
Verify that the personalized welcome message is displayed with the expected text.
Verify that the Weight Loss Progress card shows correct labels, values, units, percentage, and Set Targets button.

Verify that the profile dropdown contains all expected menu options.
Verify that the Food page shows date controls, calorie and macro sections, meal cards, and Logs section.
Verify that the Health page displays Weight, Exercise, Blood Sugar, Blood Pressure, Electrodermal Activity, Tobacco Count, and HbA1c cards.

Verify that clicking the Weight Loss arrow on Home opens the Health page.
Verify that Set Targets page loads and allows counter changes, unit toggle updates, and save action.
Verify that the Discussion page shows tabs, post composer controls, and feed item details.
Verify that the Recipe Book page shows header, tabs, and enabled Generate New Recipe button.
Verify that the Fitness Videos page shows header, categories, and video items with required details.
Verify that the Medication page shows date controls, tabs, Today's Log section, and Add Medication button.
Verify that weekly progress title and progress bar are visible and contain valid values.
Verify that food logs can be deleted for current week dates across all meal sections.
Verify that existing Weight logs are listed correctly and can be deleted successfully.
Verify that existing Exercise logs are listed correctly and can be deleted successfully.
Verify that updated target values are saved and reflected on Home cards after refresh.
Verify that Meals progress updates correctly when food is added across current-week days.
Verify that Weight progress updates correctly when weight logs are added across current-week days.
